purpose: Evidence-bound post-publication projection synchronization and Outcome-language repair.

claims.claim: Provider v0.5.62 is an immutable stable release targeting merged source commit f208e012d5345f270b9500351a6ffaecb378661e.
The repository published projection was synchronized from provider v0.5.62 assets and the next candidate advanced exactly to v0.5.63.
The public v0.5.62 archive digest recorded in release.json matches the downloaded provider archive.
Post-publication adoption validation binds an explicit English report language before invoking ai-finish.

discoveredProblems.problem: Repository release.json lagged the stable provider v0.5.62 release.
Post-publication adoption validation omitted REPORT_LANGUAGE and stopped before Outcome generation.

resolutions.resolution: Promote provider assets with the canonical synchronizer and advance candidate to v0.5.63.
Pass REPORT_LANGUAGE=en to the adoption ai-finish subprocess and add a regression assertion.

remainingRisks.risk: Unrelated user-owned dirty/detached worktrees remain outside the governed WI-20 worktree.

inferenceBoundary: No unsupported performance, quality, or time-saving benefit is claimed by this audit.
